mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (indicating supply constraints) and a rise in housing starts (indicating strong demand) signals an overheating economy that triggers a central bank tightening response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls and HOUST rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates strong household demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 (index 2017=100) for three consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate investment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime, a sudden acceleration in payroll employment above 200,000 jobs per month signals an overheating labor market that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 in a late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong residential demand, which boosts construction and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.
